description: Research data supporting paper 'An interpretable method for operational modal analysis in time-frequency representation and its applications to railway sleepers' is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Yuanchen Zeng, Zili Li. The data and codes were prepared and uploaded to 4TU.ResearchData by Yuanchen Zeng to support the published results in his paper: Zeng Y, Shen C, Nunez A, Dollevoet R, Zhang W, Li Z. (2023). An interpretable method for operational modal analysis in time-frequency representation and its applications to railway sleepers. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Restrictive Licence. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
